title: Grounding docs stay generated by this repo's own in-tree tooling, not an external hunch build
context: Commit 47a19c8 fixed a real drift: this repo's post-commit capture hook ran through a globally-installed hunch MCP server whose claudemd.ts still emits the record-counts sentence that PR #68 (commit 0eb12a3, already on main) deliberately dropped from the in-tree generator. The regenerated docs from that hook run carried the sentence back in, diverging from what this checkout's own src/integrations/claudemd.ts produces, and failing test/grounding-freshness.test.ts. An earlier auto-drafted version of this record (llm_draft, topic:null) mischaracterized this as a fresh decision to 'remove the counts sentence' -- that policy was already decided and shipped in #68; this fix only restores the committed docs to match it.
decision: The committed grounding docs (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .windsurf/rules/hunch.md) must always be regenerated with THIS repo's own in-tree CLI (npx tsx src/cli/index.ts grounding --refresh), never a global/external hunch install, which may be ahead of or behind this checkout's generator code. When a capture commit's regenerated docs disagree with what the in-tree generator produces, the in-tree generator wins and the docs get corrected -- not the other way around.
consequences: A capture made through an external/global hunch build can still drift the committed docs and fail test/grounding-freshness.test.ts until re-run through the in-tree CLI; the underlying trap (the post-commit hook itself invoking whichever hunch is on PATH) is tracked separately.
grounding-freshness test passes because committed docs match in-tree generator output.
The counts-sentence removal itself is NOT re-decided here -- that is #68's decision, already shipped on main; this record only pins generator authority, not that specific content choice.
alternatives_rejected: Treat this as a fresh decision to remove the counts sentence -- rejected: that already happened in #68 (commit 0eb12a3); re-deciding it here would duplicate and obscure the original rationale.

Update the in-tree generator to match whatever the external build produced -- rejected: the external build's behavior isn't this repo's decision to inherit; #68 deliberately dropped the sentence because it conflicted on every merge across parallel branches.

Pin the post-commit hook to a specific hunch version instead of the in-tree CLI -- rejected: adds a second place to keep in sync; using the in-tree CLI directly is a single source of truth by construction.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Update the in-tree generator to emit count sentences (delays fix, requires feature parity work)
Keep using the global MCP server (violates grounding-freshness invariant)
Maintain version-specific docs for different generators (accepts perpetual drift)
